notes.title: GIBZ - Skeleton Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24674349/79687cb3282c297d6fb5bf79f58833f123c49185.png

Finally the new update is here! New weapons, boss, hats, achievements and more!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MnVesw6PK7c

Added new boss: Skeleton Giant
Added 3 new weapons: Blunderbuss, Scoped Rifle and Tommy Gun
Added new common enemy: Skeletons
Added Traveling Merchant: A merchant that wanders around the map with a changing stock of weapons and hats (also sells some exclusives)
Added several new Hats and Facewear
Added 2 new Achievements
Added new level for encounters: Forest
Improved Zombie Surfing:

Landing after a jump creates a shockwave exploding nearby zombies
Jump height now affected by how long you hold the jump button
Camera zoomed out to give you a better view and make it easier to focus on the action
A lot more zombies to kill!

Changed player's back arm to now be visible while holding primary weapons (now also moves in relation to reload animations) + character's back arm is now positioned properly on the main menu
Changed/Improved AI Movement (will move towards targets more directly, which helps improve their level navigation)
Changed overworld map to now show a blue circle when entering safe areas instead of the red "BATTLE" one
Changed pickups so they no longer highlight if you are dead on top of them
Changed Ammo HUD to now allow more than 2 rows of bullets (ie: SUPA MG ammo doesn't cover as much of the screen as before)
Tweaked automatic weapon reload animations + slightly increased their reload times
Tweaked/Improved projectile collision on zombies (improved performance)
Tweaked various Hat Buffs:

Top Hat, Tall Top Hat and Taller Top buffs - Lose 5% money on death (was 8%), Lose 2% (was 4%), Keep 50% of money earned that round (was 40%)
Puffy Baseball Cap - 50% less damage from projectiles (up from 25%)
Black Puffy Baseball Cap - 50% Melee Knockback (up from 15%)
Fedora - 6% Shotgun Damage (up from 2%)
Gangster Hat - 6% Automatic Damage (up from 2%)
Constable Helmet - 4% Projectile Damage (up from 2%)
Army Hat - 8% Projectile Damage (up from 4%)
Gaucho Hat - 10% Sidearm Damage (up from 5%)
Bandit Mask and Custom Bandit Mask - 10% Sidearm Damage (up from 5%) and 30% Sidearm Damage (up from 15%)
Rupert's Hat - 4% Damage (up from 1%)
Samurai Helmet and Samurai Face Mask - 8% Damage (up from 4%) and 2% Damage (up from 1.5%)
Metal Mask and Bloody Metal Mask - 8% Melee Damage (up from 2%) and 25% Melee Damage (up from 5%)
Headband - 20% Melee Damage (up from 5%)
Crusher Mask and Dark Crusher Mask - 60% Melee Knockback (up from 15%)
Knight Helmet - Now provides 5% Damage resistance (along with it's current hand crossbow firerate increase)
Sunglasses - 30% less damage when leaping or lying down (up from 10%)
Custom Cap - 6% Move Speed (up from 4%)

Fixed/Improved fire trails for the Flamethrower
Fixed network sync problem with certain projectiles causing enemies to stumble randomly (should now be more consistent)
Fixed/Improved some network sync problems during the final boss fight
Fixed zombie heads not having shadows anymore after a change in a previous update
Fixed weapon graphic not changing when you pick up a weapon while lying down
Fixed dynamite being thrown after melee attacks if the dynamite throw animation was interrupted
Fixed player arm glitching if you died while throwing dynamite
Fixed visual glitch with the hand crossbow reload animation
Fixed bug (hopefully) that caused the Goliath to walk across the overworld map
Fixed bug with the Glutton boss that made jumps after it's first one not deal damage
Fixed bug where players continued to walk after they opened the pause menu while they were moving in multiplayer
Fixed enemies ignoring damage in the Tower Bridge battle (they will now come after you if you shoot them)
Fixed coin magnet problem in Zombie Surfing that could cause the coins to go crazy in online multiplayer
Fixed some possible crashes

notes.title: GIBZ - Frame Rate Update
notes.notes:
Update time! Lot's of improvements and fixes. The game is also no longer locked at 60fps and a Polish translation was added.

Performance Improvements
The game now uses a variable (unlocked) frame rate (should no longer go slow motion on fps drop which could cause online multiplayer sync issues) - can be changed back to a fixed frame rate in config.txt
Added a "Frame Rate Cap" slider to the options
Added ServerTickRate and CameraSpeed options to the game's config.txt
Added Polish Language (thanks to Kamil Tajs)
Changed weapon reloading system + reload times are now different for all guns and the hand crossbow
Tweaked Zombie Surfing mini-game: Slightly shorter, more coins and made coins easier to collect
Tweaked/Improved network syncing of common zombies
Tweaked/Improved shooting off body parts of zombies (visual improvement)
Tweaked/Improved overworld map player orientation when moving with a controller (no more moonwalking)
Tweaked the zombie crawl animation to adapt based on which arms they have
Tweaked several UI sliding animations
Changed the News page to only show the patch notes for the last 20 updates, visit the forum for the complete notes
Fixed projectile collision problem
Fixed bug that caused the Goliath to spit out more then he was supposed to after eating a zombie
Fixed problem with weapon volumes
Fixed bug with the gatling gun in local co-op that made the gun move
Fixed network problem that could occur when reviving someone that would result in a player being invisible
Fixed bug with the Machete Slinger boss that could cause him not to chase after players
Fixed Mayhem results showing negative money for players in online co-op
Fixed players in online games sometimes not being healed when entering the Wizard boss battle (by healing everyone before they enter the level instead of after)
Fixed the state of the Hospital on the overworld map not being synced properly in online games
Fixed bug that could make the player head in the HUD not match their actual head in local co-op
Fixed various small bugs and crashes

notes.title: GIBZ - Release Date + Performance Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24674349/1083c171dc9ae7940432887edb7858e6d86712cd.png

A big update was just recently released for GIBZ that improves performance, brings changes to the Mayhem and Defence mini-games, adds more variety to zombies and improves/tweaks/fixes many other things. 

GIBZ has been in early access since May last year and has since had all the planned content added (plus some extra stuff). It’s about time for it to release officially; so I’m now announcing that it will come out of early access in a couple of weeks on April 7th. 

The price will also be raised from its current $4.99 USD to $7.99 USD. So if you’re interested now is a good time to get it. 

Updates will still be made on the game, more content is a possibility as well as more events (such as Easter).

http://store.steampowered.com/app/448320

Here's a quick preview of the Performance update which shows the mini-games Mayhem and Defence with a lot more zombies:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3k3W-41cvu0

Performance Improvements (the game can now handle a lot more enemies and gibs on the screen!)
Added more variety to zombies (heads, hair colours and shirts)
Mayhem mini-game now spawns more zombies (total of 80 on screen at once, up from 45)
Gatling Defence mini-game improvements: Zombies spawn in larger numbers and are more spread out + buffed gatling gun
Zombies now look at and point their arms in the direction of their target
Increased automatic rifle clip sizes
Increased SUPA MG penetration
Improved/Tweaked Crusher AI (should be easier to dodge charge attacks now)
Tweaked enemy AI movement
Tweaked some UI elements
Tweaked pick-ups (coins and food) to make them easier to pick up
Fixed last shot of a SUPA weapon counting towards your kill-streak
Fixed ammo showing on the HUD when using using the gatling gun while you have a crossbow
Fixed some possible crashes
Fixed crash that occurred when entering the Fisherman boss fight
Fixed crash that could occur during the final boss fight
Fixed a case where zombie repellent would run out but still be active

notes.title: GIBZ - Wizard & Xmas Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24674349/3da32431ccbe123e5fb48f277e28a6c485bf7f19.png

The final boss: The Wizard is now in the game! along with new achievements, hats and some weapons. An Xmas event is also going on in-game starting from today until the 31st. Collect the two Xmas achievements and hats as well as enjoy the increased coin and hat drops in the Treasure mini-game (and free crates in the Church each day).

https://youtu.be/TSoSAyTFgO8


Added the final boss fight: The Wizard!
6 new achievements
New leaderboard: Wizard Boss Clear Time
3 new pieces of facewear
New sidearm: Hand Crossbow (found in encounters in later zones) + a SPECIAL "sidearm" acquired with a facewear buff
New melee weapon: Broadsword (unlocked via achievement)


Xmas Event! Now until the 31st of December (UTC)
2 Xmas achievements and hats to hunt down
Try and find a zombie that's getting into the holiday mood. Then kill him and take his hat.
Can you find the legendary Deerwolf and claim it's antlers?
Treasure mini-games have a small snow cloud above them - dig in the snow for improved chances of coins and hats
Each day find 8 crates sitting in the church (containing coins and random hats from any zone) 
Crates containing weapons, hats or facewear have coloured ribbons on them


Added new music for the Tower Bridge Battle
Firing your weapon now interrupts melee attacks when they are near the end of their animation
Updated Kill-streak UI (more animated / the skulls indicating kills now shrink before disappearing)
Updated Boss Health UI to now slide off screen instead of disappearing suddenly on boss death
Increased difficulty of the Goliath boss fight (increased punch damage and range, more zombies for him to eat, prioritises eating over punching)
Tweaked sound effects so their volume now scales based on where they're coming from (sounds off screen are quieter)
Increased collision box size of supa weapons making them easier to pick up when leaping over them
Added mouse click-drag scrolling to certain menus
Optimisations to sprite sheets / textures (plus the game shouldn't crash when the GPU's max texture size is less than 4096 now)
Crosshair is now hidden when using Gatling Guns
Improved/fixed up shrooms (maggot host enemy)
Various networking fixes/improvements
Various small bug fixes
Various crash fixes

Added new level for encounters in area 4 (the little area past the Tower Bridge)
Added Female playable character (10 different heads to choose from)
Added 4 new hats (find in crates, some only in the new area north of the Tower Bridge)
Added 2 new achievements
Added more head variety to zombies
Added buff info pop-ups for hats/facewear when they are on the ground (can be turned off in config.txt)
Added bullet hole decals (can be turned off in config.txt)
Updated/Tweaked background graphics for some levels
Mini-games now despawn when there are too many (rather than stopping new ones from spawning)
Tweaked coin magnet a bit (they shouldn't go crazy on Zombie Surfing anymore)
Fixed character creation problems that could occur when a previous save was deleted (mixed up save ids)
Fixed player skin being affected by shirt colour in some cases
Fixed maggots sometimes not being shaken off the player properly which resulted in them teleporting
Fixed a couple of cases where text could overlap or go off screen in some languages
Fixed a case in which dead zombies on clients would rapidly cycle through different bodies, heads and hats
Fixed problem with "lost connection" prompt which stopped you from interacting with the menu after closing it
Fixed a couple of possible crashes

notes.title: GIBZ - Melee Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24674349/39019a1de0f7e068a0f713e9dfae4b936441c27c.png
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wM8V15dV_0g
A new update to improve melee a bit. I was play testing the Fisherman boss the other week and I thought It would be cool if you could hit the fish back it him. I ended up expanding that and making it so you can hit back any enemy projectiles as well as dynamite thrown by friends. This update also includes some new achievements, a couple new melee weapons and a couple new hats.


Added 2 new melee weapons: Baseball Bat and Wood Axe (unlocked via achievements)
Added 2 new hats and 1 face wear: Mining Helmet, Headband and Blindfold (unlocked via achievements)
Added 5 new achievements
Timed melee hits with blunt weapons can now repel projectiles (Fisherman's fish, Crusher's rocks, Goliath's bones and player dynamite)
Timed melee hits with sharp weapons can now cut fish thrown by the Fisherman, negating the damage
Timed melee attacks can now block damage from attacks from certain enemies that are in front of you (eg: common zombie attacks, bat bites, etc)
Added additional sound effects to the attacks of certain enemies
Added some more variety to blood chunks and decals
Glutton Boss - New Music
Fisherman Boss - New fish sprites
Fisherman Boss - Blow attack now deals damage + added an old taunt animation which he does if he hits someone with it
Goliath Boss - Buffed and tweaked his punches
Goliath Boss - Bone spitting now takes into account the amount of limbs on the zombies he eats
Tweaked crate spawning
Crate Finder perk now also affects the amount of crates spawned in encounters
Improved Lucky Bowl Hat buff effectiveness (even smaller chance of finding empty crates)
Improved aiming and aim-line positioning when using dynamite and the flamethrower
When having both the crosshair and aimline on - projectiles will go to the crosshair (like they do when only the crosshair is on) This allows for improved aiming of dynamite and the flamethrower


Fixed melee weapon perks not applying when they should
Fixed local co-op melee turning bug (mouse movement could affect players using controllers when doing melee)
Fixed network problem related to player melee/melee animations
Fixed dynamite throwing animation not syncing over the network
Fixed pickup animation turning bug (could sometimes rapidly turn when picking up dynamite from tnt crates)
Fixed projectiles and dynamite despawning when unpausing the game
Fixed movement keys messing up sometimes after getting knocked down (which resulted in you having to release and press the key again to continue moving)
Fixed bug with Machete Slinger bat spewing which causing the bats to not spread out before going for a player
Fixed the Spitter (mutated tree stump guy) from sometimes spitting when he is not on the level yet
Fixed coloured aim-lines not hiding properly when they should
Fixed player's head sometimes turning upside down when getting up from the ground
Fixed a couple possible crashes

notes.title: GIBZ - Dynamite Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24674349/f418039b50d023ffa798d6093aba5288074ef859.png

Took a short break from working on the next boss to re-add TNT crates to the game (graphics and animation was done for them ages ago). After doing so I thought it would be cool if you could take out the dynamite from them and throw them like grenades. So now the game has throwable explosives! Throw them into the middle of a horde to see them explode into gibs!


Added TNT crates to random encounters (hit for a high damage explosion)
Added throwable sticks of dynamite (pick up from TNT crates or buy at the pub)
Buffed automatic rifle damage slightly (+5%)
Fixed networking issue that caused knockbacks on players to not sync properly
Fixed bug with Glutton (fat boss)'s start animation when in a network game
Fixed some bugs related to joining a network game just when it is closing
Fixed a couple UI problems
